row.evidence: Khoros publishes no pricing (its contact form offers "Pricing & Packaging"), says only "Unified user directory and provisioning" and "Multiple SSO options" for Iris AI, and no public SCIM documentation was found.
row.notes: Quote-only: Khoros (now khoros.ai, products Aurora AI for communities and Iris AI for social/care) has no pricing page; khoros.com/pricing redirects to a 404 on khoros.ai. No SCIM endpoint appears in the public developer portal (Marketing, Care, Flow and Brand Messenger docs, 800 pages in the sitemap). The Okta catalogue has only a 2013 'Lithium' (Khoros's former name) app with SWA, and Microsoft's Entra tutorial for Khoros Care covers SAML SSO with just-in-time user creation, no SCIM. The Iris AI governance page mentions 'Unified user directory and provisioning' without saying how. Community (Aurora) developer docs and the Atlas help community sit behind a login or bot challenge, so 'none' cannot be confirmed; status stays unknown. The Khoros Marketing Conversations API can create, list and delete users.

auth.notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 (or a personal API access token from Profile Settings); bearer tokens last 2 years.

capabilities.notes: Khoros Marketing (Iris AI) Conversations API; the create-user body takes roleId, workspaceId and an invite option.

okta.notes: Only a 2013 'Lithium' (former Khoros name) OIN app with SWA checked; searching 'khoros' returns nothing.

entra.notes: Khoros Care gallery app: SAML SSO with just-in-time user creation; no provisioning tutorial.

fallbacks.notes: Marketing, Care and Flow API docs are public; Community developer docs need an Atlas login. Microsoft's Khoros Care tutorial says the app supports just-in-time user provisioning (c16, IdP page).
